planets.name: TOI-2969 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-2969 with a 1.82-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-2969 b was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-2969. Its orbit and size follow Frensch et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
